title: pyrus haljamovae
intro: Pyrus haljamovae, commonly known as the Estonian wild pear or Haljamov's pear, is a species of pear tree native to Estonia. It is a deciduous tree with edible fruit that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The fruit of Pyrus haljamovae has been found to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health issues, including gastrointestinal problems and infections. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus haljamovae include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antiviral properties.
